g.text: Read left to right into digit groups; concatenate groups from negative to positive digits.
Collect in digit order. Keep the order inside each group.
The three digit -2 values keep input order: -12 (index 0), -2 (index 2), -12 (index 4).
Only nonempty groups appear here. Counting sort uses all 19 buckets, from digit -9 to 9.
